name: De Leuf

menus.name: set menu
menus.note: Drinks pairing €75, or €137.50 prestige wine pairing. The 'Like father, like son' signature dish is €29.50 extra; cheese instead of dessert €15 extra.

menus.name: six-course set menu
menus.note: Drinks pairing €90, or €165 prestige wine pairing; an extra course is €27.50.

menus.name: all-in Autumn Arrangement
menus.note: Includes a sparkling aperitif, amuse-bouches, 3 glasses of wine or alcohol-free drinks, water and coffee or tea. Lunch Thursday to Saturday, or dinner on Tuesday and Thursday.

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's booking page (Zenchef), or by phone or email (receptie@deleuf.nl). Lunch Thursday to Saturday from 12pm to 1pm; dinner Tuesday and Thursday from 6pm, Friday and Saturday from 6.30pm.
groups: Online bookings are for up to 6 people; for larger groups, call or email. The private Yukari room seats 4 to 14 for lunch or dinner.
